case_study_packaging.headline: Advantia Health captures $716K annual savings and 3.2× ROI in six-month strategic sourcing blitz
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: Rapid acquisition-driven growth left Advantia Health’s 60+ OB-GYN clinics with fragmented purchasing, limited spend visibility, and no dedicated procurement team. With private-equity backing from BlueMountain Capital, management needed to quickly pull cost levers to hit EBITDA targets while minimizing disruption to clinical operations. Advantia turned to Treya Partners to unlock meaningful savings and install foundational procurement discipline.
approach_summary: Analyzed $19M in annual spend across 10 categories, normalizing data from two unintegrated AP/P-card systems to pinpoint high-impact opportunities.
Negotiated key incumbent contracts—most notably reducing Athenahealth billing fees to 3.15%—leveraging benchmarks and retroactive credits.
Ran competitive RFPs that consolidated medical-supply distribution to McKesson and benchmarked IT managed services pricing.
Implemented quick-win policy changes such as enforcing 5-unit IUD order minimums and enrolling clinics in Bayer’s Confidence in Coverage program.
Built an in-house sonography staffing model, phasing out high-cost third-party services and partnering with Staffmark for overflow coverage.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya’s six-month program has locked in $533K of implemented savings and a total of $716K in annual run-rate savings once in-progress initiatives close—more than triple the project’s $225K fixed fee and comfortably above the 2× savings guarantee. Beyond the dollars, Advantia now benefits from standardized distributor relationships, tighter spend controls, and a repeatable sourcing playbook that can scale with future acquisitions.
where_we_were_unique: Delivered first measurable savings just 40 days after kickoff by targeting low-complexity policy wins.
Combined deep healthcare category expertise with hands-on data collection to overcome limited internal spend visibility.
Balanced speed and clinician buy-in—keeping preferred vendors where operationally critical while still extracting 8–19% reductions.
Exceeded the private-equity savings guarantee by 60% and generated a 3.2× return on consulting fees.

generation_notes: Savings and ROI figures sourced from close-out deck and fee schedule ($716K savings ÷ $225K fee ≈ 3.2×).
